name: coll
title: Compare a pattern with Unicode collation

origin.description: coll() compares strings with Unicode collation rules. The default locale is English so the result does not depend on the machine locale.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Text to compare. A value that is not a plain character vector is coerced, with a warning.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: If TRUE, and strength is not supplied, collation strength is 2. Otherwise the default strength is 3.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for the comparison. A single string. The default is "en".
Further arguments passed to stringi::stri_opts_collator(). An explicit strength replaces the ignore_case default.

origin.details: Strength is 2L when ignore_case is TRUE and 3L otherwise, unless strength is passed. NULL strength uses that same default. The options list stores locale and strength, then any further collator settings that were supplied.
origin.value: The pattern, with classes stringr_coll, stringr_pattern, and character, and a collator option list.

translation.description: coll() compares strings with Unicode collation. The default locale is English.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Text to compare. A string or a list of strings is kept. Other objects are coerced with a warning.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: If True, and strength is omitted, the collator strength is 2. Otherwise the default strength is 3.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for the comparison. A single string. The default is "en".

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to stri_opts_collator. strength replaces the ignore_case default. None uses that default.

translation.details: The option dict always contains locale and strength. Extra collator settings are stored after those two, in the order stri_opts_collator uses. A missing strength value is kept as NA.
translation.value: A Pattern of kind coll. The text is the pattern. options["locale"] and options["strength"] are the collator settings.
translation.example:
from stringr.pattern import coll
coll("i", ignore_case=True, locale="tr")
